# rixl_images (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "rixl_images" "all" {
  project_id = var.rixl_project_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `paginationoffset` (Number) Number of items to skip before collecting the result set.
